title: Understanding Personal Cash Flow
content: Personal cash flow measures the movement of money in and out of your financial accounts over a specific period, usually monthly. Inflow consists of income such as salary, business profits, dividends, or rental earnings. Outflow consists of living expenses, bill payments, discretionary spending, and loan EMIs. Net cash flow is Total Inflows minus Total Outflows. Positive cash flow means you earn more than you spend, leaving a surplus to save and invest.
